_about: Public datasets for first experiments, before your own history is big enough. Licences as recorded on 2026-10-14 and checked against the downloads' own READMEs on 2026-10-20; check each source again before use. A model trained on data whose licence forbids commercial use is never saved by this kit.

apache-jira.name: Apache Jira Issues
apache-jira.licence: Not checked here: read the dataset page before use.
apache-jira.use: Issue-history experiments for task duration: python -m niveloft_ml public jira --data issues.csv --mapping examples/jira-mapping.json
apache-jira.caution: Jira exports name their columns differently; examples/jira-mapping.json is a starting point, not checked against this dataset. Jira has no start or review dates, so the time measured is created → resolved.

pm-risk-raw.name: Project Management Risk Raw
pm-risk-raw.licence: Not checked here: read the dataset page before use.
pm-risk-raw.use: Project-risk classification: python -m niveloft_ml public tabular --data file.csv --target <risk column> --classify
pm-risk-raw.caution: Its columns weren't available here; choose the target column after looking at the file.

support-tickets.name: Multilingual Customer Support Tickets
support-tickets.where: Kaggle (Ticket Dataset) and the creator's Hugging Face release: aa_dataset-tickets-multi-lang-5-2-50-version.csv (newest), dataset-tickets-multi-lang-4-20k.csv, dataset-tickets-german_normalized_50_5_2.csv
support-tickets.licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0 (the creator’s current Hugging Face release)
support-tickets.use: Ticket priority from text: python -m niveloft_ml public tickets --data <file> --text subject,body --label priority (each version on its own)
support-tickets.caution: Non-commercial: experiments only. Don’t assume the current version permits training a model for a product that’s sold. The tickets are synthetic, and the versions share thousands of tickets, so never pool them.

xlam-function-calling-60k.name: Salesforce xLAM Function Calling 60K
xlam-function-calling-60k.licence: CC-BY-4.0, and you must accept the dataset’s access conditions on Hugging Face
xlam-function-calling-60k.commercial_use: allowed with attribution, subject to the access conditions
xlam-function-calling-60k.use: Measuring a model’s general function calling before any fine-tuning: python -m niveloft_ml xlam --data xlam_function_calling_60k.json, then python -m niveloft_ml tools --base-url <an OpenAI-compatible API> --model <model> --xlam xlam_function_calling_60k.json (the fixed sample of 200 when the file’s hash matches)
xlam-function-calling-60k.caution: 60,000 examples of requests mapped to functions and arguments; 1,631 fail structural checks and are never sampled. Its README says the release supports an academic paper and asks you to cite APIGen. Use it for measurement first; train on it only if a measured gap calls for it.

desharnais.name: Desharnais software effort (81 projects, from the PROMISE repository)
desharnais.where: The PROMISE Software Engineering Repository's 02.desharnais.arff (the Kaggle notebook uses the same data)
desharnais.licence: Not checked here: read the source before use.
desharnais.use: Effort-estimation research: python -m niveloft_ml public effort --data 02.desharnais.arff (ARFF or CSV)
desharnais.caution: Effort is in person-hours for whole projects, not tasks. Project, Length and YearEnd are never inputs: an identifier, and two things known only once a project is over. -1 means not recorded. PROMISE asks that work using it follow its acknowledgement guidelines.
